units.source_text: 岛村晚起，躺在床上听那赏枫游客唱谣曲［谣曲，日本古典戏曲“能乐”的歌词］的那天，

en.t: On the day Shimamura got up late and lay in bed listening to those autumn-leaf tourists singing utai, the lyrics of classical Japanese Noh drama,

units.source_text: 不知今年是否已经海吼山鸣过了？

en.t: Had the sea and mountains already roared this year, he wondered?

units.source_text: 也许由于岛村一个人旅行，在温泉乡同驹子接连幽会，

en.t: Perhaps because Shimamura was traveling alone and kept meeting Komako secretly in the hot-spring village,

units.source_text: 不觉间听觉变得特别敏锐起来，

en.t: his hearing had somehow grown strangely acute,

units.source_text: 只要想起海吼山鸣，耳边就仿佛回荡着这种远处的闷雷声。

en.t: and whenever he thought of the roaring sea and mountains, that distant, muffled thunder seemed to echo in his ears.
